info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Instrument Valuation Models API
info.description: The Financial Instrument Valuation Models API provides users with the ability to access and retrieve various financial valuation models utilized within banking and finance sectors. This API serves as a resource for analysts, developers, and institutions seeking to evaluate financial instruments' worth and make informed investment decisions. By leveraging this API, users can fetch detailed data on different valuation models, enhancing their analytical capabilities and ensuring effective risk management. Typical use cases include retrieving historical model data or finding specific valuation methodologies applicable to various financial products.

get.description: Fetches a list of financial instrument valuation models available in the system, allowing users to access detailed information and analytics related to each model.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve financial instrument valuation models. It should include the necessary parameters to specify the models being requested.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the financial instrument valuation models.

GetFinancialInstrumentValuationModelsReq.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on financial instrument valuation models in application/json format.
